---

# Overview

In `sos-bioreactivity-analyses.qmd`, biomarker reactivity was originally operationalized as
each participant's peak value at **T3 or T4** (whichever was higher) minus their T1 baseline,
per the manuscript hypothesis. Looking at when participants' biomarker values actually
peaked across all four timepoints, however, a large share of participants — especially for
the cytokines (CRP, IL-10, IL-6, TNF-alpha) — peaked at **T2**, not T3/T4. Restricting
"peak" to T3/T4 misses those people's true peak response and understates reactivity.

This notebook recalculates reactivity as follows:

- **Immune markers (CRP, IL-10, IL-6, TNF-alpha):** reactivity = participant's own maximum
  value across T1–T4 minus T1, *regardless of which timepoint the maximum occurred at*.
- **Hormones (DHEA, Testosterone, Cortisol):** these markers trend more like a *dip* than a
  spike, so reactivity = T1 minus the participant's own minimum value across T1–T4,
  regardless of timepoint.

Because a person's own peak/trough always includes T1 as one of the four candidate values,
reactivity can never be negative: it is 0 for anyone whose most extreme value *is* T1 (no
response in the hypothesized direction), and positive for anyone who moved in that direction
at some other timepoint. Ties are broken toward the earlier timepoint.

**Everyone with usable data is kept in the reactivity analyses below** — including
participants with 0 reactivity (no increase/decrease) or reactivity in the "wrong" direction
relative to hypothesis (still 0, by construction, since own_peak/own_trough can't go past T1
in the non-hypothesized direction). The only participants dropped are those with
**"Insufficient data"**: fewer than two non-missing timepoints for that biomarker, or a
missing T1 value — in either case there's no baseline to compare against, so no reactivity
score can be computed at all. This is true missing data, not a modeling choice.

This notebook also adds descriptives on the *shape* of each participant's trajectory
(increased only, decreased only, both, or flat) to better characterize the heterogeneity
underlying each biomarker's average reactivity.

Beyond the primary reactivity test, this notebook also replicates the puberty, depression
(CES-DC), social anxiety (BFNES), and exclusionary sensitivity analyses from
`sos-bioreactivity-analyses.qmd`, recomputed against these revised reactivity scores. Since
this notebook doesn't load heart-rate or subjective-stress data, those analyses are scoped to
the 7 biomarker reactivity outcomes only (not the full 13-outcome set in the original
notebook).

```{r biomarker-panels, echo=FALSE}
sos_crp_panel       <- sos_crp       |> select(SampleID, Time, CRP_log)
sos_cytokines_panel <- sos_cytokines |> select(SampleID, Time, IL10_log, IL6_log, TNFalpha_log)

sos_crp_wide <- sos_crp_panel |>

sos_hormones_wide <- sos_hormones_panel |>

```

```{r peak-trough-functions, echo=FALSE}
compute_peak_trough <- function(wide_data, cols) {
  wide_data |>
    select(SampleID, all_of(cols)) |>
    pivot_longer(-SampleID, names_to = "time_point", values_to = "value") |>
    mutate(time_point = paste0("T", str_extract(time_point, "\\d$"))) |>
    group_by(SampleID) |>
    summarise(
      n_avail     = sum(!is.na(value)),
      t1_value    = value[time_point == "T1"],
      own_peak    = if (n_avail >= 2) max(value, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      peak_time   = if (n_avail >= 2) time_point[which.max(value)] else NA_character_,
      own_trough  = if (n_avail >= 2) min(value, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      trough_time = if (n_avail >= 2) time_point[which.min(value)] else NA_character_,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      trend = case_when(
        is.na(t1_value) | n_avail < 2                ~ "Insufficient data",
        own_peak > t1_value & own_trough < t1_value   ~ "Mixed (increase & decrease)",
        own_peak > t1_value                           ~ "Increased only",
        own_trough < t1_value                         ~ "Decreased only",
        TRUE                                           ~ "No change"
      )
    )
}

# direction = "peak" for markers hypothesized to spike (immune); "trough" for markers
# hypothesized to dip (hormones). `included` marks participants eligible for the
# confirmatory reactivity test in that direction.
add_reactivity <- function(peak_trough_df, direction = c("peak", "trough")) {
  direction <- match.arg(direction)
  if (direction == "peak") {
    peak_trough_df |>
      mutate(
        own_extreme  = own_peak,
        extreme_time = peak_time,
        reactivity   = own_peak - t1_value,
        included     = trend %in% c("Mixed (increase & decrease)", "Increased only")
      )
  } else {
    peak_trough_df |>
      mutate(
        own_extreme  = own_trough,
        extreme_time = trough_time,
        reactivity   = t1_value - own_trough,
        included     = trend %in% c("Mixed (increase & decrease)", "Decreased only")
      )
  }
}

fmt_p_fdr   <- function(p) if (p < 0.001) "p[FDR] < 0.001" else paste0("p[FDR] == ", round(p, 4))
fmt_p_plain <- function(p) if (p < 0.001) "p < 0.001" else sprintf("p = %.3f", p)
```

```{r reactivity-processing, echo=FALSE}
biomarker_specs <- list(
  CRP          = list(wide = sos_crp_wide,       cols = paste0("CRP_log_", 1:4),          direction = "peak",   label = "CRP (log-transformed)"),
  `IL-10`      = list(wide = sos_cytokines_wide,  cols = paste0("IL10_log_", 1:4),         direction = "peak",   label = "IL-10 (log-transformed)"),
  `IL-6`       = list(wide = sos_cytokines_wide,  cols = paste0("IL6_log_", 1:4),          direction = "peak",   label = "IL-6 (log-transformed)"),
  `TNF-alpha`  = list(wide = sos_cytokines_wide,  cols = paste0("TNFalpha_log_", 1:4),     direction = "peak",   label = "TNF-α (log-transformed)"),
  DHEA         = list(wide = sos_hormones_wide,   cols = paste0("DHEA_log_", 1:4),         direction = "trough", label = "DHEA (log-transformed)"),
  Testosterone = list(wide = sos_hormones_wide,   cols = paste0("Testosterone_log_", 1:4), direction = "trough", label = "Testosterone (log-transformed)"),
  Cortisol     = list(wide = sos_hormones_wide,   cols = paste0("Cortisol_log_", 1:4),     direction = "trough", label = "Cortisol (log-transformed)")
)

all_reactivity <- imap_dfr(biomarker_specs, function(spec, name) {
  compute_peak_trough(spec$wide, spec$cols) |>
    add_reactivity(spec$direction) |>
    mutate(biomarker = name)
}) |>
  mutate(biomarker = factor(biomarker, levels = names(biomarker_specs)))
```

---

# Individual-Level Trend Patterns

## Trend Classification

Each participant's trajectory (T1–T4) is classified by comparing their own maximum and
minimum value to their T1 baseline: **Increased only** (a higher value appeared, but nothing
fell below T1), **Decreased only** (a lower value appeared, but nothing rose above T1),
**Mixed** (both occurred — the trajectory both rose above and fell below baseline at
different timepoints), or **No change** (every value equaled T1).

```{r trend-table}
trend_tbl <- all_reactivity |>
  mutate(trend = factor(trend, levels = c(
    "Increased only", "Decreased only", "Mixed (increase & decrease)",
    "No change", "Insufficient data"
  ))) |>
  count(biomarker, trend, .drop = FALSE) |>
  group_by(biomarker) |>
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) |>
  ungroup()

trend_tbl |>
  mutate(display = paste0(n, " (", pct, "%)")) |>
  select(biomarker, trend, display) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = trend, values_from = display) |>
  arrange(biomarker) |>
  kable(caption = "Trajectory shape by biomarker (n, % of full sample)") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r trend-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
ggplot(trend_tbl, aes(x = trend, y = pct, fill = trend)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -0.3, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(guide = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~biomarker, nrow = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% of participants") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1, size = 7)
  )
```

## Timepoint of Peak/Trough (Responders Only)

Among participants who *did* show a response in the hypothesized direction (i.e., those
included in the reactivity test below), the timepoint at which their own peak (immune) or
trough (hormones) occurred:

```{r extreme-time-table}
extreme_time_tbl <- all_reactivity |>
  filter(included) |>
  mutate(extreme_time = factor(extreme_time, levels = paste0("T", 1:4))) |>
  count(biomarker, extreme_time, .drop = FALSE) |>
  group_by(biomarker) |>
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) |>
  ungroup()

extreme_time_tbl |>
  mutate(display = paste0(n, " (", pct, "%)")) |>
  select(biomarker, extreme_time, display) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = extreme_time, values_from = display, values_fill = "0 (0%)") |>
  arrange(biomarker) |>
  kable(caption = "Timepoint of each responder's own peak (immune) or trough (hormones)") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

# Reactivity Analyses

*Reactivity is redefined as: (own peak − T1) for immune markers, and (T1 − own trough) for
hormones. Everyone with a computable reactivity score is analyzed — including participants
with 0 reactivity — except those with "Insufficient data" (see Overview).*

## Sample Sizes (Analyzed vs. Insufficient Data)

```{r inclusion-summary}
inclusion_summary <- all_reactivity |>
  group_by(biomarker) |>
  summarise(
    n_total        = n(),
    n_insufficient = sum(trend == "Insufficient data"),
    n_analyzed     = n_total - n_insufficient,
    n_responded    = sum(included),
    n_zero         = n_analyzed - n_responded,
    pct_analyzed   = round(100 * n_analyzed / n_total, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

inclusion_summary |>
  kable(
    col.names = c("biomarker", "N total", "N insufficient data", "N analyzed",
                   "N responded (reactivity > 0)", "N zero reactivity", "% analyzed"),
    caption = "Participants analyzed in the reactivity test vs. excluded for insufficient data, by biomarker"
  ) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r inclusion-results-vals, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
inclusion_sentence <- inclusion_summary |>
  mutate(txt = paste0(biomarker, ": ", n_analyzed, "/", n_total, " (", pct_analyzed, "%)")) |>
  pull(txt) |>
  paste(collapse = "; ")

insufficient_sentence <- inclusion_summary |>
  filter(n_insufficient > 0) |>
  mutate(txt = paste0(biomarker, " (n = ", n_insufficient, ")")) |>
  pull(txt) |>
  paste(collapse = "; ")
```

**Results.** The proportion of participants with a computable reactivity score (i.e.,
excluding only those with insufficient data — fewer than two non-missing timepoints, or a
missing T1) was: `r inclusion_sentence`. Participants excluded for insufficient data:
`r if (nchar(insufficient_sentence) > 0) insufficient_sentence else "none"`. Everyone else is
included in the test below, whether or not they showed a response in the hypothesized
direction (non-responders simply contribute a reactivity score of 0).

## Paired t-tests (Own Peak/Trough vs. T1)

```{r reactivity-ttests}
run_reactivity_test <- function(df) t.test(df$reactivity, mu = 0, alternative = "greater")

reactivity_tests <- all_reactivity |>
  filter(trend != "Insufficient data") |>
  group_by(biomarker) |>
  group_map(~ run_reactivity_test(.x), .keep = TRUE) |>
  set_names(levels(all_reactivity$biomarker))

reactivity_ttest_tbl <- reactivity_tests |>
  map(broom::tidy) |>
  list_rbind(names_to = "biomarker") |>
  select(biomarker, estimate, statistic, parameter, p.value) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3)))

reactivity_ttest_tbl |>
  mutate(p.value = cell_spec(p.value, bold = p.value < 0.05,
    color = if_else(p.value < 0.05, "#2166ac", "black"))) |>
  kable(col.names = c("biomarker", "Mean reactivity", "t", "df", "p (one-tailed)"), escape = FALSE) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

> **Note on interpretation.** Reactivity is bounded at 0 by construction (a person's own
> peak/trough can't fall past T1 in the non-hypothesized direction), so this one-sample test
> (reactivity > 0) is a legitimate, non-circular test of whether the average response across
> the *whole* analyzable sample — responders and non-responders alike — is reliably greater
> than zero.

## FDR Correction

```{r fdr}
peak_praw <- reactivity_ttest_tbl$p.value
names(peak_praw) <- reactivity_ttest_tbl$biomarker
peak_pfdr <- c(
  p.adjust(peak_praw[1:4], method = "fdr"),
  p.adjust(peak_praw[5:7], method = "fdr")
)

fdr_tbl <- tibble(
  group     = c(rep("Immune", 4), rep("Hormones", 3)),
  biomarker = names(biomarker_specs),
  p_raw     = round(peak_praw, 6),
  p_fdr     = peak_pfdr
)

fdr_tbl |>
  mutate(p_fdr = cell_spec(round(p_fdr, 4), bold = p_fdr < 0.05,
    color = if_else(p_fdr < 0.05, "#2166ac", "black"))) |>
  kable(col.names = c("Group", "biomarker", "p (raw)", "p (FDR)"), escape = FALSE) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

## Reactivity Descriptives

```{r reactivity-descriptives}
all_reactivity |>
  filter(trend != "Insufficient data") |>
  group_by(biomarker) |>
  summarise(
    n    = n(),
    Mean = round(mean(reactivity, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    SD   = round(sd(reactivity,   na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    Min  = round(min(reactivity,  na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    Max  = round(max(reactivity,  na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "Reactivity score descriptives across all analyzed participants (0 for non-responders)") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r plot-function, echo=FALSE}
make_reactivity_long <- function(df) {
  df |>
    filter(trend != "Insufficient data") |>
    select(SampleID, t1_value, own_extreme) |>
    pivot_longer(c(t1_value, own_extreme), names_to = "time_point", values_to = "log_conc") |>
    mutate(time_point = factor(time_point,
      levels = c("t1_value", "own_extreme"),
      labels = c("T1", "Own peak/trough")
    ))
}

biomarker_plot <- function(data, y_label, p_fdr, n_analyzed, n_total) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = time_point, y = log_conc)) +
    stat_halfeye(
      aes(fill = time_point),
      adjust = 0.5, width = 0.6, .width = 0,
      justification = -0.2, point_colour = NA, alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA, color = "gray30", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_point(
      aes(color = time_point),
      position = position_jitter(seed = 1, width = 0.1),
      size = 1.2, alpha = 0.3
    ) +
    scale_fill_viridis_d() +
    scale_color_viridis_d(guide = "none") +
    geom_signif(
      comparisons = list(c("T1", "Own peak/trough")),
      annotations = fmt_p_fdr(p_fdr),
      textsize = 3.5, vjust = 0.1, tip_length = 0.02, parse = TRUE
    ) +
    ylab(y_label) +
    xlab(NULL) +
    labs(subtitle = paste0("n = ", n_analyzed, " of ", n_total, " analyzed (non-responders included at 0)")) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          plot.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 5, b = 5, l = 5))
}

biomarker_plots <- imap(biomarker_specs, function(spec, name) {
  df         <- filter(all_reactivity, biomarker == name)
  n_analyzed <- sum(df$trend != "Insufficient data")
  n_total    <- nrow(df)
  make_reactivity_long(df) |>
    biomarker_plot(spec$label, peak_pfdr[[name]], n_analyzed, n_total)
})
```

```{r extra-data-load, echo=FALSE}
dob_session_raw <- read.csv(file.path(
  data_path, "SOS/SOS-study-monash/questionnaires/SOS_DOB_sessiondate.csv"
)) |>
  mutate(SampleID = sub("_", "", subject_spit_id))

age_df <- dob_session_raw |>
  filter(redcap_event_name == "ongoing_records_arm_1") |>
  select(SampleID, dob) |>
  mutate(dob = as.Date(dob)) |>
  inner_join(
    dob_session_raw |>
      filter(redcap_event_name == "sos_arm_1") |>
      select(SampleID, sos_session_date) |>
      mutate(sos_session_date = as.Date(sos_session_date)),
    by = "SampleID"
  ) |>
  mutate(age_at_session = as.numeric(sos_session_date - dob) / 365.25) |>
  select(SampleID, age_at_session) |>
  semi_join(
    bind_rows(sos_crp_panel, sos_cytokines_panel, sos_hormones_panel),
    by = "SampleID"
  )

dep <- read.csv(file.path(

)) |>
  select(SampleID, CESD_total)

quest_raw_q <- read.csv(file.path(proj_path, "data", "SOS_questionnaire_data.csv"))
bfnes <- quest_raw_q |>
  select(SampleID = SID, starts_with("BFNES_")) |>
  mutate(across(starts_with("BFNES_"), \(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x)))) |>
  mutate(
    BFNES_2     = 6 - BFNES_2,   # reverse-scored items: 2, 4, 7
    BFNES_4     = 6 - BFNES_4,
    BFNES_7     = 6 - BFNES_7,
    BFNES_total = rowSums(across(starts_with("BFNES_")), na.rm = FALSE)
  ) |>
  select(SampleID, BFNES_total)

))

illness <- read.csv(file.path(

)) |>
  mutate(ill_yn = nzchar(sicklast24hrs)) |>

bmi <- read.csv(file.path(

)) |>

  file.path(data_path, "SOS/SOS-study-monash/questionnaires/sos-session-runner-qual-data.csv"),
  header = TRUE
) |>
  select(saliva_1, saliva_5, saliva_6, saliva_7, saliva_8) |>

  filter(grepl("^(TAG|SOS)\\d{3}", SampleID)) |>

    bleeding_gums = as.integer(bleeding_gums == "1")

smoking <- sos_session_runner |>
  select(saliva_1, saliva_11) |>
  setNames(c("SampleID", "smokes")) |>
  filter(grepl("^(TAG|SOS)\\d{3}", SampleID)) |>

    SampleID = sub("^SOS", "TAG", SampleID),
    smokes   = (smokes == "3")
  )

ill_ids        <- illness |> filter(ill_yn) |> pull(SampleID)
excl_clean_ids <- ill_ids |>
  union(oral_health |> filter(bleeding_gums == 1) |> pull(SampleID)) |>
  union(smoking     |> filter(smokes)             |> pull(SampleID))
```

```{r puberty-load, echo=FALSE}
sos_puberty <- read.csv(here::here("data", "SOS-pubcomp.csv")) |>
  select(SampleID = SID, PUBcomp)

pds_full_raw <- read.csv(file.path(
  data_path, "SOS/SOS-study-monash/questionnaires/CESD_PDS.csv"
))

pds_f5_df <- pds_full_raw |>
  select(SampleID, PDS_F5) |>
  mutate(PDS_F5 = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(PDS_F5)))

timing_base <- sos_puberty |>
  left_join(age_df, by = "SampleID") |>
  filter(!is.na(age_at_session))

pds_raw <- pds_full_raw |>
  select(SampleID, menarche_date_raw = PDS_F9)

parse_menarche_date <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(x)
  x <- gsub("(\\d+)(st|nd|rd|th)", "\\1", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
  suppressWarnings(lubridate::parse_date_time(
    x,
    orders = c("mdy", "mdY", "BdY", "bdY",
               "YBd", "Ybd", "BY", "bY", "by",
               "Y", "dBY", "dbY"),
    quiet  = TRUE
  ))
}

dob_df <- dob_session_raw |>
  filter(redcap_event_name == "ongoing_records_arm_1") |>
  select(SampleID, dob) |>
  mutate(dob = as.Date(dob))

menarche_df <- pds_raw |>
  left_join(dob_df, by = "SampleID") |>
  mutate(
    menarche_date = as.Date(parse_menarche_date(menarche_date_raw)),
    age_menarche  = as.numeric(menarche_date - dob) / 365.25
  ) |>
  select(SampleID, age_menarche)

timing_df <- timing_base |>
  left_join(menarche_df, by = "SampleID") |>
  left_join(pds_f5_df, by = "SampleID") |>
  mutate(
    PUBcomp_c         = PUBcomp         - mean(PUBcomp,         na.rm = TRUE),
    age_at_session_c  = age_at_session  - mean(age_at_session,  na.rm = TRUE),
    age_menarche_c    = age_menarche    - mean(age_menarche,    na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  select(SampleID, age_at_session, age_at_session_c,
         PUBcomp, PUBcomp_c, age_menarche, age_menarche_c, PDS_F5)
```

```{r corrplot-helper, echo=FALSE}
plot_sig_corrplot <- function(r_mat, p_mat, title = "", type = "upper",
                              cl.ratio = 0.15, cl.cex = 1.15,
                              tl.cex = 1.0, mar = NULL, diag = FALSE) {
  if (is.null(mar)) {
    mar <- c(0, 0, if (nchar(title) > 0) 2 else 0, 0)
  }
  corrplot(
    r_mat,
    p.mat     = p_mat,
    sig.level = 0.05,
    insig     = "pch",
    pch       = 4,
    pch.col   = "black",
    pch.cex   = 2.5,
    method    = "circle",
    type      = type,
    tl.col    = "black",
    tl.srt    = 45,
    tl.cex    = tl.cex,
    col       = colorRampPalette(c("#d73027", "white", "#4575b4"))(200),
    diag      = diag,
    title     = title,
    mar       = mar,
    cl.ratio  = cl.ratio,
    cl.cex    = cl.cex
  )
}
```

```{r biomarkers-difference-wide, echo=FALSE}
# Wide-format analog of the original notebook's `biomarkers_difference`, built
# from the revised (own-peak/trough, everyone-but-insufficient-data) reactivity
# scores computed above, so all downstream puberty/dep/BFNES/sensitivity code
# below can be ported with the same variable names the original used.
biomarkers_difference <- all_reactivity |>
  filter(trend != "Insufficient data") |>
  select(SampleID, biomarker, reactivity) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = biomarker, values_from = reactivity) |>
  rename(

    il10_difference = `IL-10`,

  )

reactivity_vars <- c(
  "crp_difference", "il10_difference", "il6_difference", "tnfa_difference",

)
reactivity_labels <- c(
  "ΔCRP", "ΔIL-10", "ΔIL-6", "ΔTNF-α", "ΔDHEA", "ΔTestosterone", "ΔCortisol"
)
imm_cols_react  <- reactivity_labels[1:4]
horm_cols_react <- reactivity_labels[5:7]
```

# Hypothesis 2: Puberty and Reactivity

*Adapted from `sos-bioreactivity-analyses.qmd`: bivariate Pearson correlations between each of
the 7 biomarker reactivity outcomes (revised definition) and pubertal status (PDS+line
drawings composite), plus pubertal timing — age at menarche, PDS F5 perceived timing, and
status-for-age (status controlling for age).*

```{r puberty-processing, echo=FALSE}
puberty_reactivity <- biomarkers_difference |>
  left_join(
    sos_puberty |> mutate(PUBcomp_c = PUBcomp - mean(PUBcomp, na.rm = TRUE)),
    by = "SampleID"
  )

puberty_vars      <- c("PUBcomp")
puberty_label_map <- c(PUBcomp = "Pubertal Status (Composite)")
puberty_labels    <- unname(puberty_label_map[puberty_vars])

timing_vars   <- c("age_menarche_c", "PDS_F5")
timing_labels <- c("Age at menarche (centered, years)",
                   "PDS F5: perceived timing (1=much earlier, 5=much later)")
timing_reactivity <- biomarkers_difference |>
  left_join(timing_df, by = "SampleID")
```

## Puberty Descriptives

```{r puberty-descriptives}
sos_puberty |>
  select(-SampleID) |>
  summarise(across(everything(), list(
    Mean = \(x) round(mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    SD   = \(x) round(sd(x,   na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Min  = \(x) round(min(x,  na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Max  = \(x) round(max(x,  na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    N    = \(x) sum(!is.na(x))
  ))) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = c("variable", "stat"), names_sep = "_(?=[^_]+$)") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = stat, values_from = value) |>
  mutate(variable = recode(variable, !!!puberty_label_map)) |>
  kable(caption = "Puberty variable descriptives") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

## Correlations: All Puberty Variables × Reactivity

Rows include pubertal status (PDS+line drawings composite), age at menarche, and PDS F5
perceived timing; columns are the 7 biomarker reactivity outcomes.

```{r all-puberty-corr-matrix, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
all_pub_vars   <- c(puberty_vars, timing_vars)
all_pub_labels <- c(puberty_labels, timing_labels)

all_pub_mat <- timing_reactivity |>
  select(all_of(c(all_pub_vars, reactivity_vars))) |>
  as.matrix()
colnames(all_pub_mat) <- c(all_pub_labels, reactivity_labels)

all_pub_corrs   <- rcorr(all_pub_mat)
pub_react_corrs <- all_pub_corrs

raw_allpub_mat <- all_pub_corrs$P[all_pub_labels, reactivity_labels, drop = FALSE]
fdr_allpub_mat <- raw_allpub_mat
for (pv in all_pub_labels) {
  for (cols in list(imm_cols_react, horm_cols_react)) {
    fdr_allpub_mat[pv, cols] <- p.adjust(raw_allpub_mat[pv, cols], method = "fdr")
  }
}

plot_sig_corrplot(
  all_pub_corrs$r[all_pub_labels, reactivity_labels, drop = FALSE],
  fdr_allpub_mat,
  type = "full", cl.ratio = 0.1, cl.cex = 1.1,
  tl.cex = 0.95, mar = c(0, 0, 1, 6), diag = TRUE
)
```

*X marks indicate non-significant correlations after FDR correction (p~FDR~ ≥ .05). FDR
applied separately for each puberty/timing variable, within each reactivity domain (immune,
hormones).*

## Correlation p-values: All Puberty Variables × Reactivity

```{r all-puberty-corr-pvalues}
fdr_allpub_mat |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  mutate(across(everything(), \(x) {
    sig  <- !is.na(x) & x < 0.05
    xlab <- if_else(is.na(x), "—", as.character(round(x, 4)))
    cell_spec(xlab, bold = sig, color = if_else(sig, "#2166ac", "black"))
  })) |>
  kable(escape = FALSE,
        caption = "FDR-adjusted p-values: all puberty variables × reactivity (bold = p_FDR < .05)") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover")
```

## Correlation r-values: All Puberty Variables × Reactivity

```{r all-puberty-corr-rvalues}
r_mat   <- all_pub_corrs$r[all_pub_labels, reactivity_labels, drop = FALSE]
sig_mat <- fdr_allpub_mat < 0.05

r_df <- as.data.frame(
  matrix(
    mapply(function(r, sig) {
      cell_spec(round(r, 3), bold = sig, color = if_else(sig, "#2166ac", "black"))
    }, r_mat, sig_mat),
    nrow = nrow(r_mat), ncol = ncol(r_mat),
    dimnames = dimnames(r_mat)
  )
)

r_df |>
  kable(escape = FALSE,
        caption = "Pearson r: all puberty variables × reactivity (bold = FDR-significant, p_FDR < .05)") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover")
```

```{r all-puberty-results-vals, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
sig_allpub <- expand.grid(pv = all_pub_labels, rv = reactivity_labels, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    r     = round(r_mat[pv, rv], 3),
    p_fdr = round(fdr_allpub_mat[pv, rv], 4),
    sig   = !is.na(p_fdr) & p_fdr < 0.05,
    label = paste0(pv, " × ", rv, " (r = ", r, ", p~FDR~ = ", p_fdr, ")")
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(sig)

n_allpub_pairs_total <- length(all_pub_labels) * length(reactivity_labels)
n_sig_allpub         <- nrow(sig_allpub)
sig_allpub_text      <- if (n_sig_allpub == 0) "none survived FDR correction" else
  paste(sig_allpub$label, collapse = "; ")
```

**Results.** Across the `r n_allpub_pairs_total` puberty/timing-variable × biomarker-reactivity
pairs tested (FDR-corrected within immune and hormone reactivity separately),
`r n_sig_allpub` association`r if (n_sig_allpub != 1) "s" else ""` remained significant after
correction`r if (n_sig_allpub > 0) paste0(": ", sig_allpub_text) else "."`

## Puberty Status as Predictor of Reactivity

Simple regressions: reactivity ~ pubertal status (mean-centered).

```{r puberty-regressions, results='asis'}
pv_c <- paste0(puberty_vars, "_c")

for (i in seq_along(puberty_vars)) {
  pv  <- puberty_vars[i]
  pvc <- pv_c[i]
  cat("\n\n###", puberty_labels[i], "(centered)\n\n")
  reg_tbl <- map_dfr(setNames(reactivity_vars, reactivity_labels), function(rv) {
    dat <- puberty_reactivity |> select(all_of(c(rv, pvc))) |> na.omit()
    if (nrow(dat) < 5) return(NULL)
    fit <- lm(as.formula(paste(rv, "~", pvc)), data = dat)
    broom::tidy(fit) |>
      filter(term != "(Intercept)") |>
      mutate(term = pv, outcome = rv, .before = 1)
  }, .id = "Reactivity") |>
    select(Reactivity, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value) |>
    mutate(p_fdr = round(p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr"), 4)) |>
    mutate(across(c(estimate, std.error, statistic), \(x) round(x, 3))) |>
    mutate(p.value = round(p.value, 4))

  reg_tbl |>
    mutate(
      p.value = as.character(p.value),
      p_fdr   = cell_spec(p_fdr, bold = !is.na(p_fdr) & p_fdr < 0.05,
        color = if_else(!is.na(p_fdr) & p_fdr < 0.05, "#2166ac", "black"))
    ) |>
    kable(escape = FALSE,
          col.names = c("Reactivity outcome", "b", "SE", "t", "p (raw)", "p (FDR)")) |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE) |>
    print()
}
```

# Hypothesis 2 (continued): Pubertal Timing and Reactivity

Pubertal timing is operationalized here as (1) **age at menarche** (lower = earlier onset),
(2) perceived pubertal timing as reported on the PDS, and (3) a joint regression entering
centered pubertal status (PUBcomp) and centered age simultaneously, so each coefficient
controls for the other.

## Descriptives

```{r timing-descriptives}
timing_df |>
  select(age_at_session, PUBcomp, PDS_F5, age_menarche) |>
  psych::describe() |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  select(n, mean, sd, min, max, skew, kurtosis) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 2))) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Variable") |>
  mutate(Variable = recode(Variable,
    age_at_session = "Age at session (years)",
    PUBcomp         = "Pubertal status (Composite)",
    PDS_F5          = "Perceived Pubertal Timing",
    age_menarche    = "Age at menarche (years)"
  )) |>
  kable(caption = "Pubertal timing descriptives") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

## Correlations: Timing × Reactivity

*See the combined puberty correlation matrix above for age-at-menarche and PDS F5
correlations with all 7 biomarker reactivity outcomes.*

## Timing as Predictor of Reactivity

Each reactivity outcome is regressed on centered pubertal status (PUBcomp) and centered age
(`age_at_session_c`) simultaneously. The status coefficient reflects status beyond what is
expected for age (early timing); the `age_at_session_c` coefficient reflects age beyond what
is expected for status.

```{r timing-regressions, results='asis'}
timing_joint_tbl <- map_dfr(seq_along(puberty_vars), function(i) {
  pv       <- puberty_vars[i]
  pvc      <- paste0(pv, "_c")
  pv_label <- puberty_labels[i]

  map_dfr(setNames(reactivity_vars, reactivity_labels), function(rv) {
    dat <- timing_reactivity |>
      select(all_of(c(rv, pvc, "age_at_session_c"))) |>
      na.omit()
    if (nrow(dat) < 5) return(NULL)
    fit <- lm(as.formula(paste(rv, "~", pvc, "+ age_at_session_c")), data = dat)
    broom::tidy(fit) |>
      filter(term != "(Intercept)") |>
      mutate(
        term = if_else(term == pvc, paste0(pv_label, " (centered)"), "Age at session (centered)"),
        across(c(estimate, std.error, statistic), \(x) round(x, 3)),
        p.value = round(p.value, 4)
      )
  }, .id = "Reactivity") |>
    mutate(measure = pv_label, .before = 1)
}) |>
  group_by(measure, term) |>
  mutate(p_fdr = round(p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr"), 4)) |>
  ungroup()

for (ms in unique(timing_joint_tbl$measure)) {
  cat("\n\n###", ms, "\n\n")
  for (trm in unique(timing_joint_tbl$term[timing_joint_tbl$measure == ms])) {
    cat("\n\n####", trm, "\n\n")
    timing_joint_tbl |>
      filter(measure == ms, term == trm) |>
      select(Reactivity, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value, p_fdr) |>
      mutate(p_fdr = cell_spec(p_fdr, bold = !is.na(p_fdr) & p_fdr < 0.05,
        color = if_else(!is.na(p_fdr) & p_fdr < 0.05, "#2166ac", "black"))) |>
      kable(escape = FALSE,
            col.names = c("Reactivity outcome", "b", "SE", "t", "p (raw)", "p (FDR)"),
            caption = paste("Reactivity ~", trm, "+ other term (both centered); FDR within measure × term")) |>
      kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE) |>
      print()
  }
}
```

```{r timing-results-vals, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
fmt_timing_sig <- function(df) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return("none reached statistical significance after FDR correction")
  paste(paste0(df$Reactivity, " (*b* = ", df$estimate, ", *p*~FDR~ = ", df$p_fdr, ")"), collapse = "; ")
}

timing_summary <- lapply(puberty_labels, function(pv_label) {
  status_term <- paste0(pv_label, " (centered)")
  sig_status  <- timing_joint_tbl |> filter(measure == pv_label, term == status_term, p_fdr < 0.05)
  sig_age     <- timing_joint_tbl |> filter(measure == pv_label, term == "Age at session (centered)", p_fdr < 0.05)
  list(
    label = pv_label,
    n_status = nrow(sig_status), status_text = fmt_timing_sig(sig_status),
    n_age    = nrow(sig_age),    age_text    = fmt_timing_sig(sig_age)
  )
})

timing_results_paragraph <- paste(sapply(timing_summary, function(s) {
  paste0(
    "For ", s$label, ", ", s$n_status,
    " outcome", if (s$n_status != 1) "s" else "", " showed a significant status-beyond-age effect (",
    s$status_text, "), and ", s$n_age,
    " outcome", if (s$n_age != 1) "s" else "", " showed a significant age-beyond-status effect (",
    s$age_text, ")."
  )
}), collapse = " ")
```

**Results.** `r timing_results_paragraph` Scatter plots of timing predictors against
biomarker reactivity outcomes are shown below.

# Hypothesis 3a: Depression and Reactivity

*Adapted from `sos-bioreactivity-analyses.qmd`: Pearson correlations between CES-DC total
score and each of the 7 biomarker reactivity outcomes (revised definition), FDR-corrected
within immune and hormone reactivity separately.*

```{r dep-desc}
dep |>
  summarise(
    n    = sum(!is.na(CESD_total)),
    Mean = round(mean(CESD_total, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    SD   = round(sd(CESD_total,   na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Min  = round(min(CESD_total,  na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Max  = round(max(CESD_total,  na.rm = TRUE), 2)
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "CES-DC descriptives") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r dep-reactivity-corr}
dep_reactivity <- biomarkers_difference |>
  left_join(dep, by = "SampleID") |>
  select(-SampleID) |>
  na.omit()

dep_react_corrs <- map_dfr(setNames(reactivity_vars, reactivity_labels), function(rv) {
  ct <- cor.test(dep_reactivity[[rv]], dep_reactivity$CESD_total)
  tibble(r = round(ct$estimate, 3), p_raw = ct$p.value)
}, .id = "Reactivity") |>
  mutate(domain = if_else(Reactivity %in% imm_cols_react, "Immune", "Hormones")) |>
  group_by(domain) |>
  mutate(p_fdr = round(p.adjust(p_raw, method = "fdr"), 4)) |>
  ungroup()

dep_react_corrs |>
  select(Reactivity, r, p_fdr) |>
  mutate(p_fdr = cell_spec(p_fdr, bold = !is.na(p_fdr) & p_fdr < 0.05,
    color = if_else(!is.na(p_fdr) & p_fdr < 0.05, "#2166ac", "black"))) |>
  kable(escape = FALSE, col.names = c("Reactivity outcome", "r", "p (FDR)"),
        caption = "Correlations: CES-DC × reactivity (FDR-adjusted; bold = p_FDR < .05)") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r dep-reactivity-results-vals, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
sig_dep_react <- dep_react_corrs |> filter(p_fdr < 0.05)
n_sig_dep_react <- nrow(sig_dep_react)
dep_react_sig_text <- if (n_sig_dep_react == 0) {
  "No significant associations were observed after FDR correction"
} else {
  paste(paste0(sig_dep_react$Reactivity, " (r = ", sig_dep_react$r, ", p~FDR~ = ", sig_dep_react$p_fdr, ")"),
        collapse = "; ")
}
```

**Results.** CES-DC total score was correlated with each of the 7 biomarker reactivity
scores. FDR correction was applied within immune (4 tests) and hormone (3 tests) reactivity
separately. `r if (n_sig_dep_react == 0) "No significant associations survived FDR correction." else paste0(n_sig_dep_react, " significant association", if (n_sig_dep_react != 1) "s were" else " was", " observed: ", dep_react_sig_text, ".")`

# Hypothesis 3b: Social Anxiety and Reactivity

*Adapted from `sos-bioreactivity-analyses.qmd`: Pearson correlations between BFNES total
score and each of the 7 biomarker reactivity outcomes (revised definition), FDR-corrected
within immune and hormone reactivity separately.*

BFNES = Brief Fear of Negative Evaluation Scale (Leary, 1983); items 2, 6, 7, and 10 are
reverse-scored; total scores range from 12–60 with higher scores reflecting greater fear of
negative evaluation.

```{r bfnes-desc}
bfnes |>
  filter(!is.na(BFNES_total)) |>
  summarise(
    n    = n(),
    Mean = round(mean(BFNES_total), 2),
    SD   = round(sd(BFNES_total),   2),
    Min  = round(min(BFNES_total),  2),
    Max  = round(max(BFNES_total),  2)
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "BFNES descriptives") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r bfnes-reactivity-corr}
bfnes_reactivity <- biomarkers_difference |>
  left_join(bfnes, by = "SampleID") |>
  select(-SampleID) |>
  na.omit()

bfnes_react_corrs <- map_dfr(setNames(reactivity_vars, reactivity_labels), function(rv) {
  ct <- cor.test(bfnes_reactivity[[rv]], bfnes_reactivity$BFNES_total)
  tibble(r = round(ct$estimate, 3), p_raw = ct$p.value)
}, .id = "Reactivity") |>
  mutate(domain = if_else(Reactivity %in% imm_cols_react, "Immune", "Hormones")) |>
  group_by(domain) |>
  mutate(p_fdr = round(p.adjust(p_raw, method = "fdr"), 4)) |>
  ungroup()

bfnes_react_corrs |>
  select(Reactivity, r, p_fdr) |>
  mutate(p_fdr = cell_spec(p_fdr, bold = !is.na(p_fdr) & p_fdr < 0.05,
    color = if_else(!is.na(p_fdr) & p_fdr < 0.05, "#2166ac", "black"))) |>
  kable(escape = FALSE, col.names = c("Reactivity outcome", "r", "p (FDR)"),
        caption = "Correlations: BFNES × reactivity (FDR-adjusted; bold = p_FDR < .05)") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r bfnes-reactivity-results-vals, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
sig_bfnes_react <- bfnes_react_corrs |> filter(p_fdr < 0.05)
n_sig_bfnes_react <- nrow(sig_bfnes_react)
bfnes_react_sig_text <- if (n_sig_bfnes_react == 0) {
  "No significant associations were observed after FDR correction"
} else {
  paste(paste0(sig_bfnes_react$Reactivity, " (r = ", sig_bfnes_react$r, ", p~FDR~ = ", sig_bfnes_react$p_fdr, ")"),
        collapse = "; ")
}
```

**Results.** BFNES total score was correlated with each of the 7 biomarker reactivity
scores. FDR correction was applied within immune (4 tests) and hormone (3 tests) reactivity
separately. `r if (n_sig_bfnes_react == 0) "No significant associations survived FDR correction." else paste0(n_sig_bfnes_react, " significant association", if (n_sig_bfnes_react != 1) "s were" else " was", " observed: ", bfnes_react_sig_text, ".")`

# Exclusionary Sensitivity Analyses

*Adapted from `sos-bioreactivity-analyses.qmd`'s "Exclusionary Sensitivity Analyses" section:
re-running the primary reactivity test after excluding participants who were ill, reported
bleeding gums, or smoke — plus BMI's relationship to reactivity, and a cross-check summarizing
whether each biomarker's result holds up across all three analyses (primary, illness-excluded,
bleed+smoke-excluded).*

```{r sens-reactivity-fn, echo=FALSE}
run_reactivity_test_subset <- function(exclude_ids) {
  all_reactivity |>
    filter(trend != "Insufficient data", !SampleID %in% exclude_ids) |>
    group_by(biomarker) |>
    group_map(~ t.test(.x$reactivity, mu = 0, alternative = "greater"), .keep = TRUE) |>
    set_names(levels(all_reactivity$biomarker)) |>
    map(broom::tidy) |>
    list_rbind(names_to = "biomarker") |>
    select(biomarker, estimate, statistic, parameter, p.value)
}
```

## Illness Exclusion

Re-running the reactivity one-sample tests (own peak/trough − T1 > 0) after excluding
participants who were ill at the time of the session.

```{r sens-illness-exclusion, echo=FALSE}
illness |>
  count(ill_yn) |>
  mutate(ill_yn = if_else(ill_yn, "Yes", "No")) |>
  kable(col.names = c("Ill in last 24 hrs", "n"), caption = "Illness at time of session") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)

cat("N excluded for illness:", length(ill_ids), "\n")
```

```{r sens-illness-biomarker-ttests}
sens_ill_tbl <- run_reactivity_test_subset(ill_ids)
sens_ill_pfdr <- c(
  p.adjust(sens_ill_tbl$p.value[1:4], method = "fdr"),
  p.adjust(sens_ill_tbl$p.value[5:7], method = "fdr")
)
sens_ill_tbl <- sens_ill_tbl |>
  mutate(
    estimate  = round(estimate, 3),
    statistic = round(statistic, 3),
    parameter = round(parameter, 3),
    p.value   = round(p.value, 6),
    p_fdr     = round(sens_ill_pfdr, 4)
  )

sens_ill_tbl |>
  mutate(p_fdr = cell_spec(p_fdr, bold = p_fdr < 0.05,
    color = if_else(p_fdr < 0.05, "#2166ac", "black"))) |>
  kable(col.names = c("biomarker", "Mean reactivity", "t", "df", "p (raw)", "p (FDR)"),
        escape = FALSE,
        caption = "Reactivity one-sample tests excluding ill participants") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

## BMI × Biomarker Reactivity

For each biomarker reactivity score, we correlated BMI with the reactivity score in the
illness-excluded sample.

```{r sens-cov-processing, echo=FALSE}
cov_immune <- biomarkers_difference |>
  select(SampleID, crp_difference, il10_difference, il6_difference, tnfa_difference) |>
  left_join(bmi     |> select(SampleID, BMI),    by = "SampleID") |>
  left_join(illness |> select(SampleID, ill_yn), by = "SampleID") |>
  filter(!ill_yn | is.na(ill_yn))

cov_hormones <- biomarkers_difference |>
  select(SampleID, dhea_difference, test_difference, cort_difference) |>
  left_join(bmi     |> select(SampleID, BMI),    by = "SampleID") |>
  left_join(illness |> select(SampleID, ill_yn), by = "SampleID") |>
  filter(!ill_yn | is.na(ill_yn))
```

```{r sens-cov-bmi-corr}
immune_outcomes  <- c("crp_difference", "il10_difference", "il6_difference", "tnfa_difference")
immune_labels    <- c("ΔCRP", "ΔIL-10", "ΔIL-6", "ΔTNF-α")
hormone_outcomes <- c("dhea_difference", "test_difference", "cort_difference")
hormone_labels   <- c("ΔDHEA", "ΔTestosterone", "ΔCortisol")

run_bmi_corr <- function(outcome, data) {
  dat <- data |> select(all_of(outcome), BMI) |> na.omit()
  cor.test(dat[[outcome]], dat$BMI)
}

immune_bmi_fits  <- map(immune_outcomes,  \(o) run_bmi_corr(o, cov_immune))  |> setNames(immune_labels)
hormone_bmi_fits <- map(hormone_outcomes, \(o) run_bmi_corr(o, cov_hormones)) |> setNames(hormone_labels)

immune_bmi_praw  <- map_dbl(immune_bmi_fits,  \(ct) ct$p.value)
hormone_bmi_praw <- map_dbl(hormone_bmi_fits, \(ct) ct$p.value)
immune_bmi_pfdr  <- setNames(p.adjust(immune_bmi_praw,  method = "fdr"), names(immune_bmi_praw))
hormone_bmi_pfdr <- setNames(p.adjust(hormone_bmi_praw, method = "fdr"), names(hormone_bmi_praw))

bind_rows(
  tibble(Biomarker = immune_labels,
         r     = map_dbl(immune_bmi_fits, \(ct) unname(ct$estimate)),
         p_raw = unname(immune_bmi_praw),
         p_fdr = unname(immune_bmi_pfdr)),
  tibble(Biomarker = hormone_labels,
         r     = map_dbl(hormone_bmi_fits, \(ct) unname(ct$estimate)),
         p_raw = unname(hormone_bmi_praw),
         p_fdr = unname(hormone_bmi_pfdr))
) |>
  mutate(across(c(r, p_raw, p_fdr), \(x) round(x, 3))) |>
  mutate(p_fdr = cell_spec(p_fdr, bold = p_fdr < 0.05,
    color = if_else(p_fdr < 0.05, "#2166ac", "black"))) |>
  kable(escape = FALSE,
        col.names = c("Biomarker", "r", "p (raw)", "p (FDR)"),
        caption = "BMI x biomarker reactivity correlations, illness-excluded (FDR within immune markers / hormones)") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

## Reactivity Correlations: Illness, Bleeding Gums & Smoking Exclusion

Correlations between each of the 4 immune reactivity measures and all 7 biomarker reactivity
outcomes, recomputed after excluding participants who were ill, reported bleeding gums, or
smoke.

```{r sens-corr-clean, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
diff_matrix_clean <- biomarkers_difference |>
  filter(!SampleID %in% excl_clean_ids) |>
  select(-SampleID) |>
  as.matrix()
colnames(diff_matrix_clean) <- reactivity_labels

diff_rcorrs_clean <- rcorr(diff_matrix_clean)

raw_immune_clean_mat <- diff_rcorrs_clean$P[imm_cols_react, reactivity_labels, drop = FALSE]
fdr_immune_clean_mat <- raw_immune_clean_mat
for (im in imm_cols_react) {
  for (cols in list(imm_cols_react, horm_cols_react)) {
    fdr_immune_clean_mat[im, cols] <- p.adjust(raw_immune_clean_mat[im, cols], method = "fdr")
  }
}

# Self-correlation cells (e.g. ΔCRP row x ΔCRP column: r = 1, p = NA from rcorr)
# must be blanked in both r and p — corrplot cannot handle r non-NA / p NA.
r_immune_clean_mat <- diff_rcorrs_clean$r[imm_cols_react, reactivity_labels, drop = FALSE]
self_pairs <- outer(imm_cols_react, reactivity_labels, `==`)
r_immune_clean_mat[self_pairs]   <- NA
fdr_immune_clean_mat[self_pairs] <- NA

plot_sig_corrplot(
  r_immune_clean_mat, fdr_immune_clean_mat,
  type = "full", cl.ratio = 0.12, cl.cex = 1.1, tl.cex = 0.98, mar = c(0, 0, 1, 5), diag = TRUE
)
```

*X marks indicate non-significant correlations after FDR correction (p~FDR~ ≥ .05). FDR
applied separately for each immune reactivity measure, within each reactivity domain.*

## Sensitivity Analysis Cross-Check

A single table summarizing whether each biomarker's reactivity result holds across all
sensitivity analyses. Flagged significant (✓) when p (FDR-corrected within immune / hormone
family) < .05 for the primary and exclusion analyses. (BMI's correlation with reactivity is
reported separately above and not folded into this check, since it tests a different
question — whether BMI relates to reactivity magnitude, not whether reactivity itself is
significant.)

```{r sens-crosscheck, echo=FALSE}
biomarker_ref <- tibble(
  key       = names(biomarker_specs),
  biomarker = names(biomarker_specs),
  group     = c(rep("Immune", 4), rep("Hormones", 3))
)

primary_p <- tibble(key = names(peak_pfdr),         p_primary = unname(peak_pfdr))
ill_p     <- tibble(key = sens_ill_tbl$biomarker,    p_ill     = sens_ill_tbl$p_fdr)
clean_p   <- tibble(key = sens_clean_tbl$biomarker,  p_clean   = sens_clean_tbl$p_fdr)

fmt_p_check <- function(p, threshold = 0.05) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("—")
  lbl <- if (p < threshold) paste0(round(p, 3), "*") else as.character(round(p, 3))
  cell_spec(lbl, bold = p < threshold, color = if (p < threshold) "#2166ac" else "black")
}

bio_cross_raw <- biomarker_ref |>
  left_join(primary_p, by = "key") |>
  left_join(ill_p,     by = "key") |>
  left_join(clean_p,   by = "key") |>
  mutate(
    sig_primary = !is.na(p_primary) & p_primary < .05,
    sig_ill     = !is.na(p_ill)     & p_ill     < .05,
    sig_clean   = !is.na(p_clean)   & p_clean   < .05,
    n_sig   = as.integer(sig_primary) + as.integer(sig_ill) + as.integer(sig_clean),
    n_tests = 3L,
    consistent = case_when(
      n_sig == n_tests ~ "All sig",
      n_sig == 0L      ~ "All ns",
      TRUE             ~ paste0("Mixed (", n_sig, "/", n_tests, ")")
    )
  )

bio_cross_raw |>
  select(Group = group, biomarker, p_primary, p_ill, p_clean, Consistency = consistent) |>
  mutate(across(c(p_primary, p_ill, p_clean), \(x) map_chr(x, fmt_p_check))) |>
  rename(`Primary (FDR)` = p_primary, `Ill excl (FDR)` = p_ill, `Bleed+smoke excl (FDR)` = p_clean) |>
  mutate(Consistency = cell_spec(
    Consistency,
    bold  = Consistency == "All sig",
    color = case_when(
      Consistency == "All sig" ~ "#2166ac",
      Consistency == "All ns"  ~ "gray40",
      TRUE                     ~ "#d95f02"
    )
  )) |>
  kable(escape = FALSE,
        caption = "Biomarker reactivity: significance across all sensitivity analyses (* = p < .05)") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("hover", "striped"), full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r sens-crosscheck-text, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
n_all_sig <- sum(bio_cross_raw$n_sig == 3)
n_all_ns  <- sum(bio_cross_raw$n_sig == 0)
n_mixed   <- nrow(bio_cross_raw) - n_all_sig - n_all_ns
all_sig_biomarkers <- bio_cross_raw |> filter(n_sig == 3)          |> pull(biomarker) |> paste(collapse = ", ")
mixed_biomarkers   <- bio_cross_raw |> filter(n_sig > 0 & n_sig < 3) |> pull(biomarker) |> paste(collapse = ", ")
```

**Results.** Of the 7 biomarkers, `r n_all_sig` showed consistent significant reactivity
across all three analyses (primary, illness-excluded, and bleed+smoke-excluded)`r if (n_all_sig > 0) paste0(": ", all_sig_biomarkers)`.
`r n_all_ns` biomarker`r if (n_all_ns != 1) "s"` were consistently non-significant across all
analyses. `r if (n_mixed > 0) paste0(n_mixed, " biomarker(s) showed mixed results across analyses: ", mixed_biomarkers, ".")`

# Sensitivity Analysis: Sample Timing and Peak Location

Saliva samples were not collected at fixed clock times — T2, T3, and T4 each landed at a
somewhat different number of minutes after T1 for every participant, depending on how each
session actually ran. Since cytokines (CRP, IL-10, IL-6, TNF-alpha) turned out to peak at T2
for most participants (see the original peak-timepoint distribution), a natural question is
whether that's a genuine biological pattern or an artifact of scheduling: e.g., if
participants whose T2 sample happened to be drawn later were more likely to "catch" their
peak at T2, that would suggest the T2-peak finding is partly a timing artifact rather than a
robust kinetic pattern.

```{r timing-load, echo=FALSE}
parse_hhmm <- function(x) {
  x     <- trimws(x)
  parts <- strsplit(x, ":")
  hrs   <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sapply(parts, `[`, 1)))
  mins  <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sapply(parts, function(p) if (length(p) >= 2) p[2] else "0")))
  mins[is.na(mins)] <- 0
  ifelse(nzchar(x) & !is.na(hrs), hrs * 60 + mins, NA_real_)
}

sos_saliva_times <- read.csv(file.path(
  data_path, "SOS/SOS-study-monash/saliva/Raw_datasets/SOS_sample_report.csv"
))

saliva_timing <- sos_saliva_times |>
  rename(SampleID = TAG.ID) |>
  mutate(
    SampleID = case_when(
      SampleID == "SOS068" ~ "TAG068",
      SampleID == "SOS076" ~ "TAG076",
      .default = SampleID
    ),
    t1i_min = parse_hhmm(X1i_start), t2i_min = parse_hhmm(X2i_start),
    t3i_min = parse_hhmm(X3i_start), t4i_min = parse_hhmm(X4i_start),
    t1h_min = parse_hhmm(X1h_start), t2h_min = parse_hhmm(X2h_start),
    t3h_min = parse_hhmm(X3h_start), t4h_min = parse_hhmm(X4h_start),
    elapsed_i_T2 = t2i_min - t1i_min, elapsed_i_T3 = t3i_min - t1i_min, elapsed_i_T4 = t4i_min - t1i_min,
    elapsed_h_T2 = t2h_min - t1h_min, elapsed_h_T3 = t3h_min - t1h_min, elapsed_h_T4 = t4h_min - t1h_min
  ) |>
  select(SampleID, t1i_min, t2i_min, t3i_min, t4i_min, t1h_min, t2h_min, t3h_min, t4h_min,
         starts_with("elapsed_"))
```

## Actual Sample Collection Times

`i` = immune-tube collection (paired with CRP/cytokine reactivity); `h` = hormone-tube
collection (paired with hormone reactivity). The two are collected within the same minute for
nearly everyone, so only modest differences are expected between them.

```{r timing-descriptives-actual}
saliva_timing |>
  select(-SampleID) |>
  summarise(across(everything(), list(
    Mean = \(x) round(mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    SD   = \(x) round(sd(x,   na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    Min  = \(x) round(min(x,  na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    Max  = \(x) round(max(x,  na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    N    = \(x) sum(!is.na(x))
  ))) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = c("variable", "stat"), names_sep = "_(?=[^_]+$)") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = stat, values_from = value) |>
  mutate(variable = recode(variable,
    elapsed_i_T2 = "T1 → T2 (immune tube)",
    elapsed_i_T3 = "T1 → T3 (immune tube)",
    elapsed_i_T4 = "T1 → T4 (immune tube)",
    elapsed_h_T2 = "T1 → T2 (hormone tube)",
    elapsed_h_T3 = "T1 → T3 (hormone tube)",
    elapsed_h_T4 = "T1 → T4 (hormone tube)"
  )) |>
  kable(caption = "Actual elapsed time (minutes) between saliva collections") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

The plot below places every participant's actual T2/T3/T4 collection time (minutes since
their own T1 sample; immune tube) on the session clock, alongside the *nominal* protocol
schedule (approximate, from the study procedure — not individually measured).

```{r timing-overview-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
timeline_long <- saliva_timing |>
  select(SampleID, elapsed_i_T2, elapsed_i_T3, elapsed_i_T4) |>
  pivot_longer(-SampleID, names_to = "timepoint", values_to = "elapsed_min") |>
  mutate(timepoint = recode(timepoint,
    elapsed_i_T2 = "T2", elapsed_i_T3 = "T3", elapsed_i_T4 = "T4"
  )) |>
  filter(!is.na(elapsed_min)) |>
  mutate(timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = c("T2", "T3", "T4")))

protocol_bands <- tibble(
  label = c("MRI + SOS Task", "BFNES", "SPLT (computer task)", "Debrief"),
  xmin  = c(20, 40, 60, 100),
  xmax  = c(40, 60, 100, 160)
) |>
  mutate(xmid = (xmin + xmax) / 2, w = xmax - xmin)

ggplot() +
  geom_tile(data = protocol_bands, aes(x = xmid, y = "Protocol\n(nominal)", width = w),
            height = 0.8, fill = "gray80", color = "white") +
  geom_text(data = protocol_bands, aes(x = xmid, y = "Protocol\n(nominal)", label = label), size = 2.8) +
  geom_boxplot(data = timeline_long, aes(x = elapsed_min, y = timepoint, fill = timepoint),
               width = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_jitter(data = timeline_long, aes(x = elapsed_min, y = timepoint, color = timepoint),
              height = 0.15, alpha = 0.3, size = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(guide = "none") +
  scale_color_viridis_d(guide = "none") +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = c("Protocol\n(nominal)", "T2", "T3", "T4")) +
  labs(x = "Minutes since T1 saliva sample (actual, measured)", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

```{r timing-overview-results-vals, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
med_t2 <- round(median(saliva_timing$elapsed_i_T2, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
med_t3 <- round(median(saliva_timing$elapsed_i_T3, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
med_t4 <- round(median(saliva_timing$elapsed_i_T4, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
```

**Results.** The median actual gap from T1 was `r med_t2` minutes for T2, `r med_t3` minutes
for T3, and `r med_t4` minutes for T4 — noticeably later, and considerably more variable
across participants, than the nominal protocol schedule would suggest (which places T2
immediately after the MRI/task block, around 20 minutes post-T1). Real sessions evidently ran
behind the nominal schedule, and by a variable amount.

## Does Timing Predict Which Timepoint Captures the Peak?

For each biomarker, we tested whether the actual T1→T2 gap (`elapsed_T2`, matched to the
appropriate tube) differs between participants whose own peak (immune) or trough (hormones)
occurred at T2 versus those whose extreme value occurred at T3 or T4. If the T2-peak pattern
were a timing artifact, participants with a *longer* T1→T2 gap should be disproportionately
likely to have "caught" their peak at T2. Two-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum tests, FDR-corrected
within immune (4 tests) and hormone (3 tests) reactivity separately.

```{r timing-peak-sensitivity, echo=FALSE}
timing_join <- all_reactivity |>
  filter(trend != "Insufficient data") |>
  left_join(saliva_timing, by = "SampleID") |>
  mutate(
    tube       = if_else(biomarker %in% c("CRP", "IL-10", "IL-6", "TNF-alpha"), "i", "h"),
    elapsed_T2 = if_else(tube == "i", elapsed_i_T2, elapsed_h_T2),
    elapsed_T3 = if_else(tube == "i", elapsed_i_T3, elapsed_h_T3),
    elapsed_T4 = if_else(tube == "i", elapsed_i_T4, elapsed_h_T4)
  )

run_timing_test <- function(bio_name) {
  df    <- timing_join |> filter(biomarker == bio_name, !is.na(elapsed_T2))
  is_t2 <- df$extreme_time == "T2"
  if (sum(is_t2, na.rm = TRUE) < 2 || sum(!is_t2, na.rm = TRUE) < 2) return(NULL)
  wilcox.test(df$elapsed_T2[is_t2], df$elapsed_T2[!is_t2], exact = FALSE)
}

timing_sensitivity_tbl <- imap_dfr(biomarker_specs, function(spec, name) {
  df <- timing_join |> filter(biomarker == name, !is.na(elapsed_T2))
  wt <- run_timing_test(name)
  if (is.null(wt)) return(NULL)
  tibble(
    biomarker             = name,
    n_T2_peak             = sum(df$extreme_time == "T2"),
    n_other               = sum(df$extreme_time != "T2"),
    median_elapsed_if_T2   = round(median(df$elapsed_T2[df$extreme_time == "T2"], na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    median_elapsed_if_not  = round(median(df$elapsed_T2[df$extreme_time != "T2"], na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    p.value               = wt$p.value
  )
}) |>
  mutate(p_fdr = round(c(
    p.adjust(p.value[1:4], method = "fdr"),
    p.adjust(p.value[5:7], method = "fdr")
  ), 4))

timing_sensitivity_tbl |>
  mutate(p.value = round(p.value, 4)) |>
  mutate(p_fdr = cell_spec(p_fdr, bold = p_fdr < 0.05,
    color = if_else(p_fdr < 0.05, "#2166ac", "black"))) |>
  kable(escape = FALSE,
        col.names = c("biomarker", "n peaked at T2", "n peaked at T3/T4",
                       "Median T1→T2 gap (min), T2-peakers", "Median T1→T2 gap (min), others",
                       "p (raw)", "p (FDR)"),
        caption = "Does the T1→T2 sampling gap predict whether T2 is the peak/trough timepoint?") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r timing-peak-results-vals, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
n_timing_sig <- sum(timing_sensitivity_tbl$p_fdr < 0.05)
timing_sig_text <- if (n_timing_sig == 0) "none" else
  timing_sensitivity_tbl |> filter(p_fdr < 0.05) |> pull(biomarker) |> paste(collapse = ", ")
```

**Results.** The median T1→T2 gap was nearly identical for participants who peaked at T2
versus those who peaked at T3/T4, for every biomarker — and `r n_timing_sig` of 7 biomarkers
showed a significant difference after FDR correction (`r timing_sig_text`). In other words,
**how late the T2 sample happened to be drawn did not predict whether it captured the
peak/trough.** This is a reassuring null result: the dominance of T2 as the modal peak
timepoint for the cytokines does not appear to be a scheduling artifact.

## Peak/Trough Location by Actual Collection Time

Each point below is one participant's actual T2, T3, or T4 collection time; points are
colored by whether that timepoint was *that participant's own* peak (immune) or trough
(hormones). If timing drove peak location, red points would cluster at one end of each row;
instead they're spread throughout — consistent with the null result above.

```{r timing-peak-plot, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
peak_timing_plot_data <- timing_join |>
  select(SampleID, biomarker, extreme_time, included, elapsed_T2, elapsed_T3, elapsed_T4) |>
  pivot_longer(c(elapsed_T2, elapsed_T3, elapsed_T4), names_to = "nominal_time", values_to = "elapsed_min") |>
  mutate(
    nominal_time = str_remove(nominal_time, "elapsed_"),
    is_peak      = included & (extreme_time == nominal_time)
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(elapsed_min))

ggplot(peak_timing_plot_data, aes(x = elapsed_min, y = nominal_time, color = is_peak)) +
  geom_jitter(height = 0.15, width = 0, alpha = 0.6, size = 1.4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#d73027", `FALSE` = "gray70"),
                      labels = c(`TRUE` = "Own peak/trough", `FALSE` = "Not peak/trough"), name = NULL) +
  facet_wrap(~biomarker, ncol = 4) +
  labs(x = "Minutes since T1 (actual, measured)", y = "Nominal timepoint") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

# Biomarker Trajectories Anchored to Actual Session Timing

The plots above anchor sample timing to each participant's own T1 saliva sample. This section
instead anchors everyone's biomarker trajectory to their *actual, measured* scan and SOS-task
start times (`data/sos-session-timing.csv`), so trajectories can be viewed directly in the
context of when the scan and social-stressor task actually happened — rather than relative to
an arbitrary T1 draw time or the nominal study protocol.

```{r session-timing-load, echo=FALSE}
sos_session_timing_raw <- read.csv(file.path(proj_path, "data", "sos-session-timing.csv"))

# Anchor = each participant's own actual scan start; falls back to their own SOS
# task start for the handful of participants missing a recorded scan start time.
session_timing <- sos_session_timing_raw |>
  mutate(SampleID = sub("_", "", subject_spit_id)) |>
  mutate(
    scan_start_min      = parse_hhmm(sos_scan_actual_start),
    sos_start_min       = parse_hhmm(sos_actual_start),
    session_end_min_raw = parse_hhmm(sos_end_time),
    anchor_min          = if_else(!is.na(scan_start_min), scan_start_min, sos_start_min),
    anchor_source       = case_when(
      !is.na(scan_start_min) ~ "scan_start",
      !is.na(sos_start_min)  ~ "sos_start",
      TRUE                   ~ NA_character_
    ),
    # A handful of sos_end_time values were entered without the PM offset
    # (e.g., "05:51" instead of "17:51"), making the session appear to end
    # before the scan/task even started. A real session can't end before it
    # begins, so treat any end time earlier than this participant's own
    # anchor as a missing +12h offset and correct it.
    end_time_corrected = !is.na(session_end_min_raw) & !is.na(anchor_min) &
      session_end_min_raw < anchor_min,
    session_end_min = if_else(end_time_corrected, session_end_min_raw + 12 * 60, session_end_min_raw)
  ) |>
  select(SampleID, scan_start_min, sos_start_min, session_end_min, anchor_min, anchor_source,
         end_time_corrected)

timing_anchor <- saliva_timing |>
  left_join(session_timing, by = "SampleID") |>
  mutate(
    T1_i = t1i_min - anchor_min, T2_i = t2i_min - anchor_min,
    T3_i = t3i_min - anchor_min, T4_i = t4i_min - anchor_min,
    T1_h = t1h_min - anchor_min, T2_h = t2h_min - anchor_min,
    T3_h = t3h_min - anchor_min, T4_h = t4h_min - anchor_min,
    scan_rel = scan_start_min  - anchor_min,
    sos_rel  = sos_start_min   - anchor_min,
    end_rel  = session_end_min - anchor_min
  )
```

```{r session-timing-n, echo=FALSE}
n_anchored <- sum(!is.na(session_timing$anchor_min))
n_fallback <- sum(session_timing$anchor_source == "sos_start", na.rm = TRUE)
n_no_anchor <- sum(is.na(session_timing$anchor_source))
n_end_corrected <- sum(session_timing$end_time_corrected, na.rm = TRUE)
cat("N with a usable session anchor:", n_anchored, "of", nrow(session_timing),
    "(", n_fallback, "anchored to SOS task start instead of scan start, due to a missing scan start time;",
    n_no_anchor, "excluded entirely for missing both)\n")
cat("N with a corrected (+12h) session end time:", n_end_corrected,
    "— these had an end time earlier than their own scan/task start, indicating a likely AM/PM data-entry error\n")
```

```{r anchor-traj-data, echo=FALSE}
build_anchor_traj <- function(panel_data, value_col, tube, biomarker_name) {
  time_cols <- if (tube == "i") c("T1_i", "T2_i", "T3_i", "T4_i") else c("T1_h", "T2_h", "T3_h", "T4_h")
  timing_long <- timing_anchor |>
    select(SampleID, all_of(time_cols)) |>
    setNames(c("SampleID", "1", "2", "3", "4")) |>
    pivot_longer(-SampleID, names_to = "Time", values_to = "elapsed_min") |>
    mutate(Time = as.integer(Time))

  panel_data |>
    select(SampleID, Time, value = all_of(value_col)) |>
    filter(!is.na(value)) |>
    left_join(timing_long, by = c("SampleID", "Time")) |>
    filter(!is.na(elapsed_min)) |>
    mutate(biomarker = biomarker_name)
}

anchor_traj_data <- bind_rows(
  build_anchor_traj(sos_crp_panel,       "CRP_log",          "i", "CRP"),
  build_anchor_traj(sos_cytokines_panel, "IL10_log",         "i", "IL-10"),
  build_anchor_traj(sos_cytokines_panel, "IL6_log",          "i", "IL-6"),
  build_anchor_traj(sos_cytokines_panel, "TNFalpha_log",     "i", "TNF-alpha"),
  build_anchor_traj(sos_hormones_panel,  "DHEA_log",         "h", "DHEA"),
  build_anchor_traj(sos_hormones_panel,  "Testosterone_log", "h", "Testosterone"),
  build_anchor_traj(sos_hormones_panel,  "Cortisol_log",     "h", "Cortisol")
) |>
  mutate(biomarker = factor(biomarker, levels = c(
    "CRP", "IL-10", "IL-6", "TNF-alpha", "DHEA", "Testosterone", "Cortisol"
  )))

event_lines <- tibble(
  event = factor(
    c("Scan start", "SOS task start", "Session end"),
    levels = c("Scan start", "SOS task start", "Session end")
  ),
  x = c(
    mean(timing_anchor$scan_rel, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(timing_anchor$sos_rel,  na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(timing_anchor$end_rel,  na.rm = TRUE)
  )
)
```

Dashed vertical lines mark the **mean** (across participants) time of each session milestone,
relative to each participant's own anchor (0 = their own scan start, or SOS task start for the
few participants missing a scan start time). Thin gray lines are individual participants'
observed trajectories; the black line is a loess smooth across everyone, plotted against real
elapsed time rather than the ordinal T1–T4 sequence.

```{r anchor-traj-plot, fig.width=13, fig.height=7}
ggplot(anchor_traj_data, aes(x = elapsed_min, y = value)) +
  geom_vline(data = event_lines, aes(xintercept = x, color = event),
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_line(aes(group = SampleID), color = "gray70", alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(color = "gray70", alpha = 0.35, size = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", formula = y ~ x, color = "black", fill = "gray40",
              alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2", name = "Session milestone (mean time)") +
  facet_wrap(~biomarker, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
  labs(x = "Minutes since scan start (actual, anchored per participant)",
       y = "Concentration (log-transformed)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

**Note.** T1 saliva samples were typically collected *before* the scan (negative values on the
x-axis) as a pre-scan baseline. The loess bands flare out at the far left/right edges of each
panel where data are sparse (few participants contribute samples that far from the mean
timing) — treat the smooth as most reliable in the denser middle region, roughly spanning scan
start through the SOS task start.
